description: UK employee take-home pay for 2026-27: Income Tax (England, Wales and Northern Ireland, or Scottish bands), employee Class 1 National Insurance (8% from £12,570 to £50,270, 2% above) and student loan (Plans 1, 2, 4, 5 at 9%, postgraduate 6%). Pension, salary sacrifice and other tax codes are not included. UK (gov.uk Rates and thresholds for employers 2026 to 2027), as of 2026-11-22. General estimate for one year: not tax advice, not the payroll withholding.
